subject: Operator activity export: encryption & per-user/session slice options
messages:
From: Sanjay Menon <sanjay.menon@novamed.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: compliance@novamed.com
Date: 2026-11-07T09:14:00-08:00
Subject: Export options for operator/admin activity (scope & encryption)

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. As part of our SIG+SOC2 evidence collection we need an export of operator/admin activity for the last 90 days scoped to NovaMed tenant IDs and per-user session boundaries. A few specific asks from our side: 

- Can exports be sliced by user-session (start/end) rather than only by calendar day?
- Do you support envelope encryption (customer-managed key) for the exported files in transit and at rest?
- We need a manifest with checksums and a signed timestamped attest statement.
- Expected delivery formats (parquet vs jsonl) and an approximate export runtime estimate for a 90-day window.

Appreciate a short note back with options and a sample manifest layout.

Sanjay
Sanjay Menon
Security Lead, NovaMed
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Menon <sanjay.menon@novamed.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-07T10:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Export options for operator/admin activity (scope & encryption)

Hi Sanjay — thanks for the clear list. High level answers below; attaching an export spec workbook and a sample manifest. I pulled in Kimberly (product) and Neha (compliance ops) for details.

- Per-user/session slicing: supported. We can generate exports keyed by session_id with start/end timestamps. Sessions are defined by operator authentication events + inactivity window (configurable; default 30m).
- Encryption: we support TLS in transit and server-side AES256 by default. For at-rest/envelope encryption we offer two options: 1) Redwood-managed envelope keys (AWS KMS) or 2) customer-managed keys (CMK) via our KMS integration — customer keys used to wrap archive keys before upload. We can deliver files to your S3 with SSE-C or AWS-KMS with your key.
- Formats & manifests: we produce gzip-compressed JSONL or Parquet; the manifest includes file name, record counts, sha256 checksum, export time window, keyed-salt used for signing, and a separate attestation object signed by Redwood.
- Runtime: for a 90-day operator activity slice for a tenant with ~4k daily operator events, typical export to parquet + compression completes within 2–3 hours on Dedicated capacity; JSONL may be slightly longer due to larger payloads. If you need streaming near-real-time export we can provide incremental deltas every 4 hours.

Action items:
1) Please confirm desired slice key (session_id vs auth_session_id) and whether you require CMK.
2) If CMK, share the KMS ARN and whether you prefer delivery to your S3 or our secure transfer endpoint.
3) We'll schedule a 30-minute runbook review (Neha will send calendar invite).

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachment: admin_activity_export_spec.xlsx (XLSX, 120KB)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Menon <sanjay.menon@novamed.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-08T11:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Export options for operator/admin activity (scope & encryption)

Hi Sanjay — following up with some implementation notes and constraints so you can plan: 

- Session slicing nuance: if you want strict per-session joins (including cross-device operator sessions), we'll surface session_id and authentication_token_id; for customers that have long-running automation we can flag service accounts separately. Please indicate whether service accounts should be excluded.
- CMK onboarding: we require a one-time handshake where you provide a KMS public wrapping key and an IAM role for cross-account writes. We do not store your CMK private key.
- Manifest signing: we provide a detached signature (RFC 7515 style) of the manifest and include a signed timestamp. If NovaMed requires ledger-level attestation (HSM-signed), we can route through our HSM-backed signer and include an audit log of the signing operation.
- Sampling & retention: exports are a point-in-time snapshot. If NovaMed prefers a sampled attested bundle (e.g., 10% per-tenant sample for very large customers) we can do that — but note auditors often prefer full-window exports for operator/admin activity.

I'll loop Neha to set the runbook review and share our sample manifests.

Kimberly Park
Product Manager, Security & Compliance
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
